_metadata.description: Reusable ATS and career-platform adapter definitions, retrieval capabilities, implementation difficulty and verification constraints.
_metadata.implementation_policy: Prioritise public unauthenticated feeds and documented job-board endpoints. Do not infer support from an ATS name or a plausible URL. Verify each employer source and application destination independently.

difficulty_scale.easy: Documented public feed or endpoint, predictable board identifier, vacancy descriptions and application URLs available with few requests.
difficulty_scale.moderate: Public endpoint/feed exists but has pagination, detail requests, XML/HTML parsing, incomplete fields or undocumented behavior.
difficulty_scale.hard: Undocumented/custom career-site behavior, complex tenant configuration, multi-request extraction, or significant source-specific validation.
difficulty_scale.blocked_or_partner_dependent: No established general public retrieval route; requires employer/agency credentials, partner access, or manual investigation.

_metadata.employer_verification_note: Company examples are discovery leads unless an official company careers page or live source URL is explicitly recorded as evidence in the employer-source registry.
_metadata.sequence_rationale: User-approved order on 2026-11-12: implement and validate Workable first, then Workday, then investigate SAP SuccessFactors using employer-specific Crawlee inspection.

greenhouse.notes: Reference implementation. Official Job Board GET endpoints expose public job data without authentication. Validate meta.total and completeness; this endpoint returns the board's published jobs in one response.

ashby.notes: Use the public Job Postings API only. Do not use jobPosting.list/job.list; those require jobsRead credentials and can include unlisted postings unless filtered. Board slug is taken from jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug}. Adapter deferred on 2026-11-09 after user-confirmed partner enquiry email; awaiting Ashby's response on partner eligibility, feed provisioning, employer opt-in and permitted use.

teamtailor.notes: Implemented public Teamtailor RSS adapter. The supplied careers URL must identify its /jobs page; append .rss to that path. Feed supports offset/per_page pagination (default first 100), including custom careers domains. Maps GUID, title, sanitized HTML description, advert link, publication date, multiple locations and department; preserves remoteStatus, role, division and optional company metadata in raw_payload. The advert link opens the vacancy page containing the application action; it is not claimed to be a direct application-form URL. Incomplete pagination or mapping is reported as partial.

workable.notes: Workable's official API reference documents this unauthenticated public careers endpoint and its account/job fields. The endpoint may redirect to the apply.workable.com widget route; follow a bounded redirect chain. `details=true` includes descriptions. The response documents `url` as the application-form URL and `application_url`/`shortlink` as job-page URLs. Keep the slug in employer/source configuration. This is distinct from the authenticated customer SPI API at /spi/v3/jobs. Adapter code and mocked tests are present; live board validation, completeness comparison and operational rate behavior remain pending.

zoho_recruit.notes: No documented public vacancy API established. Public careers page may contain escaped job JSON in HTML. Requires robust parsing, tenant-specific validation and exact job/application link testing. Do not call this a supported API.

zoho_recruit.research_gap: Only one employer board was independently confirmed in this research pass. Do not invent additional ATS associations.

workday.notes: Observed public careers-site CXS endpoint, not a documented public job-board API. POST listing requests; common page size is 20; details require another request using externalPath. Host cluster, tenant, locale and site must be parsed independently; large boards may have result caps. Reactivated by user decision on 12 November 2026 as implementation priority 2, after Workable. Validate URL parsing, listing completeness, pagination caps, detail retrieval and application URLs across more than one employer before claiming reusable support.

sap_successfactors.notes: No single general unauthenticated endpoint is established for all tenants; Career Site Builder configuration and tenant-specific integrations matter. SAP's legacy RSS/XML career-site response reached end of development on 14 November 2025 and is scheduled for deletion on 14 May 2027, so do not build on it. Investigate after Workable and Workday using Crawlee HTTP-first against each employer's current official public careers site. Inspect redirects, sitemaps, structured data, embedded payloads and public network requests; use bounded Playwright only when required by evidence and permitted. Store retrieval_profile in the employer/source registry. Generalise into one reusable adapter only if multiple employers share a stable permitted retrieval pattern; otherwise use generic Crawlee retrieval with explicit employer-specific configuration.

neptune_erecruit.notes: Do not conflate Graylink's Neptune ATS with the eRecruit-hosted Shoprite careers portal. Shoprite's live portal is on shoprite.erecruit.co; Graylink independently markets Neptune as its ATS. No evidence found that these are the same product or that Shoprite's portal is Graylink Neptune. Inspect each employer site and network calls independently.

neptune_erecruit.research_gap: No three employer career URLs could be reliably confirmed as Graylink Neptune customers. The listed employers are eRecruit portal examples only and must not be labelled Graylink Neptune customers without separate evidence.

leaply.notes: Available evidence describes Leaply as a recruitment engine/marketplace that sources, screens and verifies candidates, not a conventional employer ATS with a public vacancy board. No public job feed or employer-board URL pattern established. Keep as a discovery lead, not an ATS adapter, until candidate-facing job listings and retrieval are proven.

jobadder.notes: API access requires OAuth2 and customer-authorized integration; partner documentation advises contacting the API team. Not a general unauthenticated cross-employer job-board API. A public agency widget or page can be investigated separately.

placement_partner.notes: Keep in scope as a separate agency-source adapter. Discover and verify agency IDs, parse vacancy cards/details and validate every job destination. Accept redirects only when the final destination is the exact vacancy/application flow; flag generic agency homepages, search pages, unrelated jobs, login walls and broken links. Do not count agencies as direct employers.
